stock.description: Smart Digital Technology Group Ltd. operates as an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of entertainment and trade of chemicals. It operates through the Media & Culture Business segment includes investment, production and distribution of entertainment content such as films and drama series. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
